events.text_en: Ân Thanh Linh of Vũ Linh Đường, twenty years old, casts a bell for the Nhiếp family of the Tower that rings only when someone is listening at a door.
Vũ Linh Đường hangs its first bell line in the canopy over the forest road from Thu Trì, one bell to a tree, joined by the roots.
Chung Tàn Hưởng gives Vũ Linh Đường to Ân Thanh Linh, saying she hears bronze better than he does, and keeps his father's unlit lamp.
